patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff bundles unrelated tmux changes and does not produce a usable fixed fuzz target in this environment; fixed-side evidence here comes from the minimal source-grounded regsub.c guard cp[1] != '\0' executed in the same Docker image with the frozen Stage-04 instrumentation.

root_cause_criterion.description: Whenever regsub_expand treats cp[0] as a backslash escape introducer and executes cp++, it must ensure the next source byte cp[1] is not the string terminator.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: In the vulnerable original, the protected cp++ executes with escape_guard.next_char=0. In the fixed original, the same trailing-backslash witness leaves the protected event guarded, and the adjacent escape_digit case executes cp++ genuinely with escape_guard.next_char=49.

nodes.description: After the vulnerable escape-handling cp++, the loop cursor lands exactly on the replacement string terminator.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original records escape_advance.cp_offset=1 and escape_advance.with_len=1, so cp equals with + strlen(with) immediately after cp++.

nodes.description: The next loop-condition read dereferences cp after the cursor has advanced past the replacement buffer terminator.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original records loop_oob_read.cp_offset=2 while loop_oob_read.with_len=1, matching the one-past-end loop test that ASan reports as the heap-buffer-overflow read.

edges.description: The byte that was only checked as cp[1] at the root guard becomes the current *cp value immediately after the vulnerable cp++.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original records escape_guard.next_char=0 and the paired escape_advance.current_char=0, so the unchecked terminator byte is the value consumed after cp++.

edges.description: After cp++ lands on the terminator, the for-loop increment advances the same cursor one more byte before the next loop-condition read.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original records escape_advance.cp_offset=1 and the paired loop_oob_read.cp_offset=2, proving the cursor advanced from the terminator to one-past-end before the sink read.
